d_and_a.source: Depreciation of property and equipment, cash flow statement (10-K FY2024 exhibit 99.1 Q4'24: 11,946/15,311; FY2025 10-K ~$21.1B, 21,136 per stockanalysis.com). Excludes amortization of intangibles (not separately found).

capex.source: Purchases of property and equipment, cash flow statement: 32,251/52,535 per Q4'24 exhibit 99.1; FY2025 91,447 per stockanalysis.com cash flow page

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 15% (402,836 vs 350,018); fade as the base grows and cloud/AI growth normalises toward mature levels.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2024 and FY2025 operating margin was 32% (10-K); trimmed 1pt for rising depreciation from heavy AI capex.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate recent effective tax rate (mid/high teens) given foreign-derived income deductions; not verified against the 10-K tax note.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 depreciation was 5.2% of revenue (21,136/402,836) and rising with capex; 7% average over projection.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 22.7% of revenue; management guided ~$175-185B for 2026 (FY2025 annual report, ~43%+ of revenue), assumed to moderate to ~20% average over the period.

wacc.source: Assumption: risk-free ~4.3%, beta ~1.1, ERP ~5%, almost no debt so WACC ≈ cost of equity ~9-10%; 9% used.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal GDP growth, kept below WACC.

net_debt.source: Long-term debt 46,547 (10-K FY2025, acc. 0001652044-26-000018) minus cash, equivalents and short-term marketable securities $126.8B (FY2025 10-K MD&A; rounded to $0.1B). No commercial paper at 12/31/2025; current portion of LT notes not separately found, so may be slightly understated debt. Leases excluded.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted-average shares used in diluted EPS computation, FY2025 total, 10-K FY2025 (acc. 0001652044-26-000018), millions
